summary: Blue Gold Limited, a Cayman Islands metal-mining foreign private issuer, furnished a Form -6K containing a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement for a November 17, 2026 meeting held virtually. The filing asks shareholders to revoke and replace July 24, 2026 resolutions that delegated reverse-split ratio authority to the board, following a Deputy Registrar letter citing section 13 of the Companies Act, and to approve a fixed 1-for-20 consolidation plus conforming charter amendments. No transaction, price, premium or advisor is involved; watch only for quorum and vote outcome.
